name: multigres-mcp
description: Postgres diagnostics and cluster operations for Multigres clusters.
long_description: Postgres diagnostics (schemas and objects, read-only SQL, query plans with hypothetical indexes, top queries, index advice, health checks) and cluster tools: cluster status and backups through multiadmin, node logs over a direct connection to each node, and in the unrestricted mode primary switchover and backup control. Read-only by default.

database_url.title: Gateway connection string
database_url.description: Postgres connection string of the Multigres gateway, for example postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:15432/postgres

admin_url.title: multiadmin address
admin_url.description: multiadmin HTTP address, for example http://localhost:15000. The cluster tools are registered only when it is set.

admin_token.title: multiadmin token
admin_token.description: Bearer token for multiadmin started with --enable-auth.

node_host_map.title: Node host map
node_host_map.description: reported=reachable host pairs, comma separated, for direct node connections. See the README.

access_mode.title: Access mode
access_mode.description: restricted (read-only) or unrestricted (adds the write tools).

sql_timeout.title: SQL timeout
sql_timeout.description: Statement timeout for the SQL every tool sends, as a Go duration such as 25s.
